0x05.note: DEGREES PER DETENT: the dial gives 360 / byte detents per turn, so the stock 5 is NayaFlow's default of 72 and the slider minimum of 5 detents is the byte 72. Measured live 2026-09-16 (SCRUM-50): 36 -> about 10 detents, 10 -> about 33, 90 -> exactly 4. Strength did not change (that is 0x06). module_fields.setting_to_wire converts; the app stores detents per turn.

TUNE.note: Scroll axes are cat 4 (0x0a/0x0b) and cat 6 (0x0c/0x0d) -- the SAME bytes a Touch carries at 0x0d-0x10 for its 2-finger scroll. The Tune has no pointer axes of its own; forcing cat 0/cat 1 into these fields does move the cursor, but slowly, and no config value changes that.

TRACK.confidence: CONFIRMED by a live write + read-back (2026-09-02)
TRACK.source: NayaFlow flash of the 'Naya Track Left' profile, captured on the wire (device/out/track-swap-writes.json slot 4) and read back (device/out/module-probe-after-trackflash.json). Our encoder re-encodes that captured write byte-exactly.
TRACK.note: The four category-3 fields 0x0b-0x0e ARE the Track's buttons 1-4, and the value is a mouse-button bitmask (1=M1 2=M2 4=M3 8=M4) -- proven by a single-field write in C2. They are NOT limited to mouse buttons: NayaFlow wrote a second Track profile on 2026-09-03 with 4-byte KEYPRESS records (D/R/S/T) in those same fields, so the field's record TYPE decides what it holds. The earlier claim that Track has no keypress gesture fields was wrong -- we had only ever seen these fields holding masks. A Track config is 15 fields (0x00-0x0e).

TOUCH.note: Category-3 fields are mouse-button records (tap-to-click), not axes. Only 0x13 (M3 = 3-finger tap) survived the fresh 2026-09-02 write; 1- and 2-finger tap are not stored on the device at all, so they are firmware or host defaults. The Touch's 1-finger CURSOR gestures have no device fields at all -- only its 2-finger scroll is stored (cat 4/cat 6 at 0x0d-0x10). Its cursor is native module firmware, which is why a Tune cannot be made to behave like one by copying config. Confirmed live 2026-09-09 with a Touch docked: 1-finger cursor, 1-finger tap = left click and 2-finger tap = right click all work with 0x05-0x08, 0x0b, 0x0c empty; pinch/spread (0x11/0x12) are empty because NayaFlow never writes them, not because they do nothing -- written by hand they are a working zoom axis (2026-09-18). See module_fields.FIRMWARE_DEFAULTS.
